name: MotionCore: A Latent Neural Simulator for Video Generation with Rigid-Body Dynamics

raw_payload.title: MotionCore: A Latent Neural Simulator for Video Generation with Rigid-Body Dynamics
raw_payload.summary: Video generation models can produce highly realistic videos while generating physically inconsistent object motion. This limitation suggests that visual modeling alone may not provide a transferable representation of physical dynamics. We introduce MotionCore, a framework for learning physical dynamics via a learnable latent neural operator which focuses on rigid-body video generation. We introduce a latent neural simulator learning to predict the evolution of object-level physical states from observed motion. Its predictions are then converted into spatially aligned latent controls for a controllable video diffusion model. The generator serves as a visual interface: it provides appearance and scene detail, while the learned dynamics model specifies the physical trajectory. We construct our training dataset comprising semi-realistic synthetic multi-object videos with rich annotations. We evaluate MotionCore on public physical video generation benchmarks and conduct controlled ablations to assess the contribution of learned dynamics relative to other priors. Results indicate that MotionCore improves physical consistency and trajectory obedience in the evaluated rigid-body settings, while maintaining comparable visual quality. MotionCore outperforms larger general and physics-aware video generators while using substantially fewer parameters.
